H4977G.name: Mattan
H4977G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4977G.brief: Priest of Baal, killed during Jehoiada's reforms.
H4977G.short: Mattan, a priest of Baal, was killed during Jehoiada's religious reforms.

H4977H.name: Mattan
H4977H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4977H.brief: Father of Shephatiah, an opponent of Jeremiah.
H4977H.short: Mattan was the father of Shephatiah, one of the officials who opposed the prophet Jeremiah.

H4983H.name: Mattaniah
H4983H.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4983H.brief: Son of Heman, a musician in David's court.
H4983H.short: Mattaniah, a son of Heman, was a musician in King David's court.

H4983G.name: Mattaniah
H4983G.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H4983G.brief: Levite singer and gatekeeper during the time of Nehemiah.
H4983G.short: Mattaniah, a Levite singer and gatekeeper, served during the time of Nehemiah.

H4983I.name: Mattaniah
H4983I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4983I.brief: Levite, grandfather of Jahaziel, who prophesied during Jehoshaphat's reign.
H4983I.short: Mattaniah, a Levite, was the grandfather of Jahaziel, who prophesied during King Jehoshaphat's reign.

H4983J.name: Mattaniah
H4983J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4983J.brief: Levite who helped cleanse the temple during Hezekiah's reign.
H4983J.short: Mattaniah, a Levite, helped cleanse the temple during King Hezekiah's reign.

H4983K.name: Mattaniah
H4983K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4983K.brief: Descendant of Zattu, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4983K.short: Mattaniah, a descendant of Zattu, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4983L.name: Mattaniah
H4983L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4983L.brief: Descendant of Elam, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4983L.short: Mattaniah, a descendant of Elam, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4983M.name: Mattaniah
H4983M.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4983M.brief: Descendant of Pahath-moab, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4983M.short: Mattaniah, a descendant of Pahath-moab, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4983N.name: Mattaniah
H4983N.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4983N.brief: Descendant of Bani, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4983N.short: Mattaniah, a descendant of Bani, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4983O.name: Mattaniah
H4983O.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4983O.brief: Levite singer, descendant of Asaph, during Nehemiah's time.
H4983O.short: Mattaniah, a Levite singer and descendant of Asaph, served during Nehemiah's time.

H4983P.name: Mattaniah
H4983P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4983P.brief: Levite appointed as a treasurer during Nehemiah's time.
H4983P.short: Mattaniah, a Levite, was appointed as a treasurer during Nehemiah's time.

H4992.name: Mattattah
H4992.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4992.brief: Descendant of Hashum, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4992.short: Mattattah, a descendant of Hashum, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4982G.name: Mattenai
H4982G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4982G.brief: Descendant of Hashum, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4982G.short: Mattenai, a descendant of Hashum, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4982H.name: Mattenai
H4982H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4982H.brief: Descendant of Bani, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4982H.short: Mattenai, a descendant of Bani, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4982I.name: Mattenai
H4982I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4982I.brief: Priest during the time of Joiakim.
H4982I.short: Mattenai was a priest who served during the time of Joiakim.

H4993H.name: Mattithiah
H4993H.desc: Singer living at the time of United Monarchy
H4993H.brief: Levite musician during the time of David.
H4993H.short: Mattithiah, a Levite, served as a musician during the time of King David.

H4993G.name: Mattithiah
H4993G.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H4993G.brief: Levite in charge of baking bread in the temple.
H4993G.short: Mattithiah, a Levite, was in charge of baking bread in the temple.

H4993I.name: Mattithiah
H4993I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4993I.brief: Descendant of Nebo, who divorced his foreign wife.
H4993I.short: Mattithiah, a descendant of Nebo, divorced his foreign wife during Ezra's reforms.

H4993J.name: Mattithiah
H4993J.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4993J.brief: Levite who assisted Ezra in reading the Law.
H4993J.short: Mattithiah, a Levite, assisted Ezra in reading the Law to the people.

H4902G.name: Meshech
H4902G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4902G.brief: Son of Japheth and grandson of Noah.
H4902G.short: Meshech, a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah, is mentioned in the Table of Nations.

H4920.name: Meshelemiah
H4920.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H4920.brief: A Levite gatekeeper in the time of David.
H4920.short: Meshelemiah (also called Shelemiah), a Levite gatekeeper during David's reign.

H4921.name: Meshillemith
H4921.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H4921.brief: A priest who settled in Jerusalem after the exile.
H4921.short: Meshillemith (also called Meshillemoth), a priest who settled in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H4919G.name: Meshillemoth
H4919G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4919G.brief: An Ephraimite leader during the reign of Pekah.
H4919G.short: Meshillemoth, an Ephraimite leader who opposed the enslavement of Judean captives.

H4918H.name: Meshullam
H4918H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4918H.brief: Son of Zerubbabel, a descendant of David.
H4918H.short: Meshullam, a son of Zerubbabel, mentioned in the genealogy of David's descendants.

H4918I.name: Meshullam
H4918I.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4918I.brief: A Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham.
H4918I.short: Meshullam, a Gadite leader during the reign of Jotham, king of Judah.

H4918J.name: Meshullam
H4918J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4918J.short: Meshullam, a Benjamite, was one of the sons of Elpaal.

H4918M.name: Meshullam
H4918M.desc: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918M.brief: A priest who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.
H4918M.short: Meshullam (also called Ahzai), a priest who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H4918K.name: Meshullam
H4918K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918K.brief: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.
H4918K.short: Meshullam, a Benjamite, was among those who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H4918L.name: Meshullam
H4918L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918L.short: Meshullam, a Benjamite, was the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah.

H4918N.name: Meshullam
H4918N.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4918N.brief: A Levite who supervised repairs in Josiah's time.
H4918N.short: Meshullam, a Levite, was among those who supervised the repairs of the temple during King Josiah's reign.

H4918G.name: Meshullam
H4918G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4918G.brief: Grandfather of Shaphan the scribe during Josiah's reign.
H4918G.short: Meshullam, the grandfather of Shaphan the scribe, mentioned during King Josiah's reign.

H4918P.name: Meshullam
H4918P.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918P.brief: Opposed Ezra's plan to put away foreign wives.
H4918P.short: Meshullam, along with Jonathan the son of Asahel, opposed Ezra's plan to put away foreign wives.

H4918Q.name: Meshullam
H4918Q.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918Q.brief: An Israelite who had married a foreign woman.
H4918Q.short: Meshullam, one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman during the Babylonian exile.

H4918O.name: Meshullam
H4918O.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918O.brief: A leader summoned by Ezra to help teach the Law.
H4918O.short: Meshullam, a leader summoned by Ezra to assist in teaching the Law to the people.

H4918V.name: Meshullam
H4918V.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918V.brief: A leader who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H4918V.short: Meshullam, one of the leaders who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.

H4918U.name: Meshullam
H4918U.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918U.brief: A priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah.
H4918U.short: Meshullam, a priest who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah and participated in the dedication of the wall.

H4918W.name: Meshullam
H4918W.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918W.brief: A Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem after the exile.
H4918W.short: Meshullam, a Benjamite who lived in Jerusalem after the Babylonian exile.

H4918X.name: Meshullam
H4918X.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918X.brief: A priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim.
H4918X.short: Meshullam, a priest who served during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

H4918Y.name: Meshullam
H4918Y.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918Y.brief: A priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim.
H4918Y.short: Meshullam, head of the priestly family of Ginnethon during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

H4918Z.name: Meshullam
H4918Z.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918Z.brief: A Levite gatekeeper during Nehemiah's time.
H4918Z.short: Meshullam, a Levite gatekeeper who served during the time of Nehemiah.

H4918R.name: Meshullam
H4918R.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918R.brief: Helped repair the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah.
H4918R.short: Meshullam, son of Berechiah, helped repair the wall of Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

H4918S.name: Meshullam
H4918S.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918S.brief: Helped repair the Old Gate in Jerusalem's wall.
H4918S.short: Meshullam, son of Besodeiah, helped repair the Old Gate during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's wall.

H4918T.name: Meshullam
H4918T.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4918T.brief: A priest who stood beside Ezra during the reading of the Law.
H4918T.short: Meshullam, a priest who stood beside Ezra during the public reading of the Law.

H4922.name: Meshullemeth
H4922.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4922.brief: Mother of Amon, king of Judah.
H4922.short: Meshullemeth, the mother of Amon, king of Judah, was from Jotbah.

H4968.name: Methuselah
H4968.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H4968.brief: The oldest person mentioned in the Bible.
H4968.short: Methuselah, the son of Enoch, was the oldest person mentioned in the Bible, living 969 years.

H4967.name: Methushael
H4967.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H4967.brief: A descendant of Cain; father of Lamech.
H4967.short: Methushael, a descendant of Cain, was the father of Lamech.

H4936.name: Misham
H4936.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4936.short: Misham, a Benjamite, was one of the sons of Elpaal mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin.

H4927H.name: Mishma
H4927H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4927H.short: Mishma, a descendant of Simeon, was the son of Mibsam and the father of Hammuel.

H4927G.name: Mishma
H4927G.desc: Arabian living at the time of the Patriarchs
H4927G.brief: A son of Ishmael, Abraham's son.
H4927G.short: Mishma was one of the twelve sons of Ishmael, Abraham's son by Hagar, and is listed among the chiefs of the Ishmaelite tribes.

H4925.name: Mishmannah
H4925.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H4925.brief: A Gadite warrior who joined David at Ziklag.
H4925.short: Mishmannah, a Gadite, was one of the warriors who joined David at Ziklag when he was fleeing from Saul.

H4954.name: Mishraites
H4954.brief: A clan descended from Shobal, of the tribe of Judah.
H4954.short: The Mishraites were a clan descended from Shobal, who was a descendant of Judah through Caleb.

H4981.name: Mithnites
H4981.brief: The people of an unknown place or family.
H4981.short: The Mithnites are mentioned in the context of Joshaphat the Mithnite, one of David's mighty warriors, but no further information about them is provided.

H4990G.name: Mithredath
H4990G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4990G.brief: The treasurer of King Cyrus of Persia.
H4990G.short: Mithredath, the treasurer of King Cyrus of Persia, was responsible for overseeing the return of the temple articles to Sheshbazzar, the prince of Judah.

H4990H.name: Mithredath
H4990H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H4990H.brief: A Persian official who opposed the rebuilding of Jerusalem.
H4990H.short: Mithredath was one of the Persian officials who wrote a letter to King Artaxerxes, accusing the Jews of rebuilding Jerusalem's walls.

H4957.name: Masrekah
H4957.brief: The royal city of Samlah, an Edomite king
H4957.short: Masrekah, the royal city of Samlah, one of the ancient kings of Edom before any Israelite king reigned (<ref="Genesis 36:36; 1Ch.1.47">Genesis 36:36; 1Ch.1.47</ref>).

H4980.name: Mattanah
H4980.brief: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey
H4980.short: Mattanah, a place where the Israelites camped during their journey through the wilderness (<ref="Numbers 21:18-19">Numbers 21:18-19</ref>).

H4902H.name: Meshech
H4902H.brief: A nation, descendant of Japheth; associated with Tubal
H4902H.short: Meshech, a nation descended from Japheth (<ref="Genesis 10:2">Genesis 10:2</ref>), often mentioned together with Tubal as trading partners of Tyre (<ref="Ezk.27.13">Ezk.27.13</ref>) and allies of Gog (<ref="Ezk.38.2, 3; 39:1">Ezk.38.2, 3; 39:1</ref>).

H4902I.name: Meshech-Tubal
H4902I.brief: Two nations mentioned together; defeated by Babylon
H4902I.short: Meshech-Tubal, two nations mentioned together as having been defeated by the Babylonians and lying in the grave with the uncircumcised (<ref="Ezk.32.26">Ezk.32.26</ref>).

H4956.name: Misrephoth-maim
H4956.brief: A place near Sidon where the Canaanites fled
H4956.short: Misrephoth-maim, a location near Sidon, was where the Canaanites fled after being defeated by Joshua.

H4989.name: Mithkah
H4989.brief: An Israelite campsite during the wilderness wanderings
H4989.short: Mithkah was a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness journey, between Terah and Hashmonah.

H4932G.name: Second Quarter
H4932G.brief: District in Jerusalem mentioned by Huldah and Zephaniah
H4932G.short: The Second Quarter was a district in Jerusalem mentioned in connection with the prophetess Huldah (<ref="2Ki. 22:14; 2Chr. 34:22">2Ki. 22:14; 2Chr. 34:22</ref>) and in Zephaniah's prophecy (<ref="Zeph. 1:10">Zeph. 1:10</ref>).

H4996.name: Thebes
H4996.brief: Ancient Egyptian city, known for its wealth and power
H4996.short: Thebes, an ancient Egyptian city, known for its wealth and power, mentioned in prophecies of judgment against Egypt (<ref="Jer. 46:25; Ezek. 30:14-16; Nah. 3:8">Jer. 46:25; Ezek. 30:14-16; Nah. 3:8</ref>).

H4905.name: Maskil
H4905.brief: A musical or literary term in the Psalms
H4905.short: Maskil is a term found in the superscriptions of several psalms, possibly indicating a contemplative or instructive psalm or a specific musical style.
